flow: N74/N76 provider protocol call using immutable Binding version
N85 optional Browserless-specific real effect evidence
authorityLaws: protocolVersion is part of immutable AgentInterface and TransportBinding identity and is never guessed from endpoint URL.
A2A protocolVersion accepts Major.Minor form; MCP protocolVersion uses a valid date-version string.
A legacy interface row without protocolVersion is readable as historical state but cannot be silently re-advertised or routed as a current R14 interface; explicit operator migration is required.
A2A client configuration cannot override a conflicting immutable Binding protocolVersion.
MCP task client rejects a Binding whose protocolVersion differs from the supported MCP protocol.
TransportCredentialBinding persists only references and required scopes; no access token, client secret or resolved Authorization header is stored.
A transport credential proof must belong to the Delegation source identity and be currently authenticated.
CredentialReference resource must cover the exact immutable Binding endpoint.
CredentialReference requested scopes and PolicyDecision granted permissions must both cover Binding security requirements.
CredentialMaterialProvider is the external secret authority; material is resolved only at HTTP-effect time.
Resolved credential issuer/resource/scopes/expiry are revalidated before use and secret-bearing headers remain transient.
A credential that is valid for another resource, another identity or insufficient scope does not authorize this Binding.
BrowserlessTurnEffectLedgerReader is read-only and domain-specific; it does not import or duplicate Harness write authority.
Missing Browserless ledger/table means UNKNOWN rather than NO_EFFECTS.
An existing authoritative Browserless turn_effects table with no exact turn row means the bounded SEND fence was not crossed and can yield NO_EFFECTS for that effect family.
Browserless UNKNOWN stays replay-unsafe.
Browserless COMPLETED is normalized as COMMITTED without idempotency evidence and therefore blocks ordinary replay.
Browserless ledger row and receipt identity are bound to exact turnRequestId, promptDigest and targetCoordinate/targetResource.
R14 does not create a universal effect ledger and does not claim universal business-side-effect exactly-once semantics.
R14 does not change R12 durable failover authority or R11 semantic-completion authority.

localSubstrateFinding.scope: ChatGPT Web continuation SEND effect fence only
